name: Risk of Rain 2
description: Co-op roguelike third-person shooter. Windows dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: steam_server_query_port / game port (default 27015); change via console cvars or an autoexec config.

notes: The server is configured through console cvars (steam_server_name, steam_server_password, sv_maxplayers ...) which can be typed into the panel console or placed in Risk of Rain 2_Data/Config/server.cfg. Some setups additionally require the Steam client libraries to be present on the host. The server binary is Windows-only.
